hypotheses.construction_plan: For each target member, specialize the template F(x)*G(x)*F(x) by substituting the mapped placeholders: F is the outer function, G is the inner function, x is the variable. The two resulting terms are the summands of the raw expression.
hypotheses.rationale: The two summands share the common AC pattern theta0**2*theta1, where theta0 is the repeated outer factor (V(p) or W(q)) and theta1 is the inner factor (G0(p) or H0(q)). The template F(x)*G(x)*F(x) captures this repeated-factor structure with one variable and two function slots, explaining both non-identical terms as instances of the same parameterized form.
